venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Super lively Bingo Tuesday at Close Company ATL. Got hit quickly at open with guests looking for the meal deal; new Beltline signage from Wonderworks bringing walk-ins. Regulars stayed the entire Bingo; more new faces via Eventbrite. Second wave ~9pm after opener left — kitchen efficient through last call. Beat target by +51% ($3,429 vs $2,272). 86'd: fernet branca, apple jack brandy.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: Sleepier Tuesday than anticipated. Nice pop at the start and a decent Bingo crowd, but the usual late-night crowd never materialized. Eli trained tonight with KE & BT and did well; Jarred held down the kitchen. Missed target by ~54%. 86: GF Pockets. Low: Campari, Lairds. Comps 3.6% (industry + Bingo credits).

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: Lots of large parties and first-timers celebrating. DC/AM $1,106.57, D&C PM $5,697.65. Plated Armanino event (23 guests, Vauxhall 6-9pm) added $4,574.60 event net sales and $2,919 event food for a total night of $11,378.82 incl. events. Non-event performance missed target by ~15% but incl. events the venue crushed the number. Comps 6.55%. Chef Lucas & Nate handled event; Antonio & Archer held the line.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Mellow start turning into a lucrative evening. Hosted the Heaven Hill Distillery crew (Ian Orekondy) — party grew from 8 to 16; team spread them out, comped shot du jours and popcorn. Two-tops dominated reservations; mostly walk-in twos, a few solos and first dates. Bar full most of the night; tapered off at midnight. Beat target by +17% ($3,685 vs $3,150). Comps 6.3% (gifts + F&F). 2 DOF + 1 N&N glass breakage.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: Steady Tuesday. Started sleepy with 11 covers — used the lull for deep cleaning across kitchen, bar, and cage. Got progressively busier; room full by 9:30pm and stayed full to last call. Marquee $4,139, Standing Room $0. Beat target by +16% ($4,139 vs $3,573). Favorite moment per Joe: overhearing a first date conversation at the bar.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: No EON report submitted for 4/21. Last DC EON posted to #dc_eon_report was 4/19 02:04 EDT for 4/18 service — 4/19, 4/20, and 4/21 are all now outstanding. Recommend following up with Cory / Kevin / Josh (now a 3-day reporting gap).

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: Slow Tuesday. Busy 9am start with strong hotel guest traffic, then a lull that allowed early cuts. Kelly on-site capturing photos/video ahead of tomorrow's menu flip. Very smooth evening; Sierra trained with Emma at the host stand and Kaylee on SA. Sun Club closed early — pool attendant became sick mid-shift, couldn't cover. Hot Eye $0. Missed target by ~39% ($4,370 vs $7,200). Morning MB $890 / 42g, Evening MB $3,480 / 69g.
